[DAY1 13:25:30 - DAY1 13:26:00]
Tasha: "Orchid tip." "Oh," I say. I turn my head left and see Tasha taking something out. Alice: "A whisk." Tasha: "A whisk, a whisk, and a mixing stick." I step forward and pick up a brush. "So professional," I say. Tasha: "Piping tip." I fiddle with the object in my hand, then put it back and pull my hand back. Tasha: "Crisp." I move right holding the box with both hands. Tasha: "Scraper." "What's this?" I ask as I raise my hand. I sit down. "Oh, oh, oh," I say. Tasha: "Scraper." Alice: "Scraper." Tasha: "Ah, it can be flat or used to cut dough." I nod, reach out, pick something up, and fidget with it. "Got it, got it," I say. I continue fiddling with it.

[DAY1 13:27:30 - DAY1 13:28:00]
Tasha: "Use paper cups." I pick up a bottle of water, move it, turn right, and walk into the kitchen. I reach into a box and take out two bottles of water, turn left, walk forward, turn right, and set the water down. "Where's the oven?" I ask. Tasha: "By the mixer." I turn my head left and say, "So, where should we put it? Where's the best place to put it?" "Here, this, hmm," I add. Tasha: "Just put it here. I think it should go on top of the oven." Alice: "Peeler." I turn my head right, point at the oven, turn on the tap and drink from the bottle, wave, screw the cap onto the bottle, and then turn right and walk forward. Tasha: "Uh, on top of the microwave would be better." Alice: "On top of the microwave." Shure: "We only have a microwave here." "We bought an oven," I say.

[DAY1 14:01:00 - DAY1 14:01:30]
I wade into the water and swish the water off the dishes. "What is this?" I ask. Tasha: Guess. "Making a batter," I say as I hold and fidget with the cutlery. Shure: Beating eggs, right? Tasha: Oh, right. "Eggs — I think we might need more," I say. I shake off the water, turn my head, and hand the cutlery to Shure. "The same, right? Just one," I add. Shure: But it looks like this. Shure: And then you put it on like this, oh. "Oh, OK, OK, got it," I say.

[DAY1 13:40:00 - DAY1 13:40:30]
I place the microwave on top of the oven and turn my head to the right. Tasha: Actually, we could roast some chicken too. I lower my head and search for the microwave's power cord, then fiddle with the microwave to find the cable jack and cables. Brilliant. Lucia: Let's leave the piping bag for later. Lucia: Otherwise, it might spill everywhere. Tasha picks up the microwave cord; I take the microwave's power cord and tinker with the oven. Tasha: These are all ingredients. I plug the cable into the wiring panel and tap the plug. Tasha: Just put them together. Tasha: Put the powders together. Tasha: Keep the ingredients together.

[DAY1 14:03:01 - DAY1 14:03:30]
I turn my head side to side and gesture while I speak, then splash water. Tasha: "Really?" I turn my head right, nod, and speak. Tasha: "No, no, no, forget it." "Wanna go up?" I lower my head and wash the dishes. Alice: "Never prayed for a marriage match, never." I shake off the water, put down the knife, look up and down, pick up the cutlery, and pour out the new utensils I forgot. I lift the faucet and keep washing the dishes. Lucia: "Whose baby is this?" Lucia: "Seems like a part of some appliance." I turn my head back to look at everyone. Tasha: "Yeah, it was a freebie." Tasha: "Not as useful as this one." I turn my head to the right and back and continue washing the dishes. Lucia: "Oh, then this isn't needed?"

[DAY1 14:04:00 - DAY1 14:04:30]
I clean the bucket, shake the water off, and put it down. Alice asks, "So where did that bag go?" "Sorry, it's gone," I say. I turn right and pick up the cutlery. Alice asks, "It looked a lot like trash; could it have been thrown away by mistake?" I continue cleaning the dishes: I turn off the faucet, shake water off and put dishes into the bucket, then pick up the sponge and a spoon from the new set. I turn on the faucet, wash the spoon and other cutlery, and then turn off the faucet.
